Teaching-beat floor across all three: minimum 7/10 (opinionated senior at phase 2 and phase 8; fast operator at phase 4 and phase 8) — per check_strategy_tie_in.md §1, 7 is the facilitator-premium floor, not a REVISE trigger (only <7 blocks).
